clauses.text: 4. That after marriage the petitioner/wife was taken to her matrimonial house at …………. with all her stridhan articles, which was a palatial structure resided by the respondent and thereafter the disquiet started in between the petitioner/wife and the respondent over the issues of providing food, clothing etc. and the petitioner/wife was pressurized in several pretext by the respondent/husband to hand over all her gold ornaments and valuables as stridhan articles in his custody, even threatened several times by the respondent/husband 3 that otherwise she would be driven out from her matrimonial house, but on all occasions, your petitioner/wife remain silent and complied the same by handing over all her gold ornaments and valuables in his custody without expressing any outrage with a hope of leading a happy conjugal life with the respondent/husband which could be a matter of time but still today all her stridhan articles are lying in custody of the respondent/husband. 5. That out of the wedlock, they have two children, one daughter namely ………. And one son namely……….. 6. That gradually the ghost reveals from the attitude of the respondent/husband. Your petitioner/wife realized the aggressive adamant and furious nature of the respondent/husband and was always subjected to mental torture and cruelty by the respondent/husband and during her course of stay at her aforesaid matrimonial house, the respondent/husband always misbehave with the petitioner on different issues and inflicted torture upon her both physically and mentally on the fulfilment of unlawful demand of the respondent/husband. 7. That it is pertinent to mention herein that the petitioner gave birth of her first child was baby girl and due to the female child the respondent along with his all the family members blamed your petitioner and mentally tortured upon her . Furthermore the respondent physically assaulted the petitioner for giving the birth of a female child. 8. That ever since their marriage, the Petitioner has been suffering physical and mental abuse, pain, helplessness, unhappiness and anger on account of the respondent. That since the beginning of the marriage, the respondent has become drunkard. He used to demand money from the Petitioner and for her failure to meet his demand, the Petitioner/wife has been beaten up and subjected to cruelty. The respondent has constantly tortured her. He even stopped to paying anything for house hold expenses. 4 9. That the respondent/husband used to remain most of the time in a drunken state and often the respondent/husband came late at night in a drunken state and without any reason physically assaulted your petitioner. Further it is submitted by the petitioner/wife that in spite of performing all kinds of jobs like cooking, cleaning at utensils etc. like a maid servant from morning to night, but could not satisfy the respondent at any point of time, rather their greed increases time to time. 10. That your Petitioner continued to tolerate and endure all these for the sake of her children despite of the fact that her life was made miserable due to the angry and bad temperament, aggressive, indifferent behaviour, continuous insults and very cold attitude of the Respondent/Respondent. He is a habitual drunkard and often goes into rage session and during his rage sessions he torments your Petitioner mentally and physically. 11. That during the course of her stay at the matrimonial house your petitioner/wife was not given any space nor freedom and was always dominated by the unlawful demand of the respondent/husband and every now and then dictated by the respondent/husband upon her to leave her matrimonial home as might be he wanted to have separate conjugal life and these sort of mental torture continued since the beginning of the marriage. 12. That your petitioner tried her best to reconcile with the respondent/husband without expressing any outrage with a hope of leading a happy conjugal life but all her efforts were rejected by the respondent. That on ……… due to heinous torture of the respondent/husband, the petitioner/wife compelled to leave her matrimonial house and stayed at a rented residence at ………….. 13. That since that date i.e. on ……….., the respondent/husband did not take any information about the whereabouts of the petitioner/wife and sent any amount of money towards her maintenance and 5 neglected the petitioner in spite of her repeated demand days after days without any reason.

IN THE COURT OF THE LEARNED DISTRICT JUDGE  
AT ALIPORE  
 
MATRIMONIAL SUIT NO. ……. …. OF 2021  
 
IN THE MATTER OF: - 
An application seeking dissolution of marriage 
on the score of ‘Cruelty’ within the meaning of 
section 13 (1) ( ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 
1955;  
 
AND 
 
IN THE MATTER OF: - 
SMT. REBATI SANTRA , wife of Shibunath 
Santra , daaughter of Swapan Ojha,  aged about 
30 years, residing at ……….. , having phone no. 
+91-………………………. and having e -mail id 
…………………………..  
  .... PETITIONER  
 
-VERSUS - 
 
SRI SHIBUNATH SANTRA , son of ………..  aged 
about 30  years, presently residing at 
………having phone no. +91 -………………………. 
and having e -mail id …………………………..  
  ….. RESPONDENT   2 
 
The humble petition on behalf of the petitioner 
above named most respectfully  
 
S H E W E T H: - 
 
1.   That the petitioner and the respondent are both Hindu and 
citizens of India.  
 
2. That the Petitioner and the Respondent were married according to 
Hindu Rites and Customs on  ………., subsequently the said 
marriage was registered on ………. under the Hindu Marriage 
Registration Act. 
 
3. That at the time of marriage, the petitioner/wife was given several 
articles like jewelleries, wooden coat, huge quantity of gold 
ornaments, along with gold necklace and gold ring of the respondent 
etc. by her father and other relatives as a bridal gift for the upliftment 
of the bridegroom’s house and the social status of the groom with a 
hope and dream that her daughter would live happily at her 
matrimonial house with all those stridhan articles an d as such the 
father of the petitioner had arranged for a l avish wedding and spent 
huge amount in order to fulfil all the demands of the respondent.  
 
4. That after marriage the petitioner/wife was taken to her matrimonial 
house at …………. with all her stridhan articles, which was a palatial 
structure resided by the respondent and thereafter the disquiet 
started in between the petitioner/wife and the respondent over the 
issues of providing food, clothing etc. and the petitioner/wife was 
pressurized in several pretext by the respondent/husband to hand 
over all her gold ornaments and valuables as stridhan articles in his 
custody, even threatened several times by  the respondent/husband  3 
that otherwise she would be driven out from her matrimonial house, 
but on all occasions, your petitioner/wife remain silent and complied 
the same by handing over all her gold ornaments and valuables in his 
custody without expressing any outrage with a hope  of leading a 
happy conjugal life with the respondent/husband which could be a 
matter of time but still today all her stridhan articles are lying in 
custody of the respondent/husband. 
5. That out of the wedlock, they have two children, one daughter namely 
………. And one son namely……….. 
6. That gradually the ghost reveals from the attitude of the 
respondent/husband. Your petitioner/wife realized the aggressive 
adamant and furious nature of the respondent/husband and was 
always subjected to mental torture and cruelty by the 
respondent/husband and during her course of stay at her aforesaid 
matrimonial house, the respondent/husband always misbehave with 
the petitioner on different issues and inflicted torture upon her both 
physically and mentally on the fulfilment of unlawful demand of the 
respondent/husband. 
7. That it is pertinent to mention herein that the petitioner gave birth of 
her first child was baby girl and due to the female child the respondent 
along with his all the family members blamed your petitioner and 
mentally tortured upon her . Furthermore the respondent physically 
assaulted the petitioner for giving the birth of a female child. 
8. That ever since their marriage, the Petitioner has been suffering 
physical and mental abuse, pain, helplessness, unhappiness and 
anger on account of the respondent. That since the beginning of the 
marriage, the respondent has become drunkard. He used to demand 
money from the Petitioner and for her failure to meet his demand, the 
Petitioner/wife has been beaten up and subjected to cruelty. The  
respondent has constantly tortured her. He even stopped to paying 
anything for house hold expenses.   4 
9. That the respondent/husband used to remain most of the time in a 
drunken state and often the respondent/husband came late at night 
in a drunken state and without any reason physically assaulted your 
petitioner. Further it is submitted by the petitioner/wife that in spite 
of performing all kinds of jobs like cooking, cleaning at utensils etc. 
like a maid servant from morning to night, but could not satisfy the 
respondent  at any point of time, rather their greed increases time to 
time. 
10. That your Petitioner continued to tolerate and endure all these for 
the sake of her children despite of the fact that her life was made 
miserable due to the angry and bad temperament, aggressive, 
indifferent behaviour, continuous insults  and very cold attitude of the 
Respondent/Respondent. He is a habitual drunkard and often goes 
into rage session and during his rage sessions he torments your 
Petitioner mentally and physically. 
11. That during the course of her stay at the matrimonial house your 
petitioner/wife was not given any space nor freedom and was always 
dominated by the unlawful demand of the respondent/husband and 
every now and then dictated by the respondent/husband upon her to 
leave her matrimonial home as might be he wanted to have separate 
conjugal life and these sort of mental torture continued since the 
beginning of the marriage.  
12. That your petitioner tried her best to reconcile with the 
respondent/husband without expressing any outrage with a hope of 
leading a happy conjugal life but all her efforts were rejected by the 
respondent. That on ……… due to heinous torture of the 
respondent/husband, the petitioner/wife compelled to leave her  
matrimonial house  and stayed at a rented residence at ………….. 
13. That since that date i.e. on ……….., the respondent/husband did 
not take any information about the whereabouts of the petitioner/wife 
and sent any amount of money towards her maintenance and  5 
neglected the petitioner in spite of her repeated demand days after 
days without any reason. 
 
14. That the Petitioner tried his level best to adjust and readjust with the 
respondent, but all his efforts went in vain. 
 
15.  
 
16. That in the above situation, the marriage of the Petitioner and the 
respondent has miserably failed and has irretrievably broken down 
and there is no chance of restoration/further reunion of the same. 
The petitioner and the respondent at present have no conjugal 
association and they are living separately since ……. 
 
17. That there is no collusion and/or connivance by between the Parties 
in presenting the instant suit. 
 
18. That there is no improper delay in filing/submitting the instant 
application and as much there is no impediment in granting the relief 
as prayed for. 
 
19. That the parties to the suit lastly resided together as and wife at 
………….., within the jurisdiction of this Learned Court.
